correctness.rationale: Birkhoff--James orthogonality in smooth l_3^2 gives an explicit one-parameter tangent direction. Signed-coordinate symmetries reduce the optimization to two orientations with 0<=t<=1. All branches except 0<t<1,s>t satisfy the analytic bound 2^(2/3), while an explicit rational-parameter witness exceeds that bound. Interior stationarity yields two polynomial equations. Their exact resultant factors through one degree-fourteen polynomial in u=t^3; exact Sturm counts give only two candidate u-roots, and the quadratic branch signs eliminate one. The surviving common stationary solution is uniquely isolated and hence is the attained global maximizer. The standalone checker reconstructs the exact factorization and root counts.

value.rationale: The rectangular constant is a classical natural invariant of Banach-space geometry, and l_3 is a canonical non-Hilbert space. Its p=3 value has appeared only numerically in the original 1970 computation and in a more accurate 2021 table. Replacing those approximations by an exact algebraic characterization, with a unique maximizing Birkhoff--James tangent configuration, resolves a concrete long-standing natural invariant rather than an arbitrary slice or routine recomputation.
